parameters.help_en: The metric that you want to use. For more information, see CloudMonitor metrics (https://cms.console.aliyun.com/metric-meta/acs_ecs_dashboard/ecs)

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time. Example: `2024-08-06 10:15:00`

parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page.

Default value: 1000.

The maximum value of the Length parameter in a request is 1440

每页显示的记录条数，用于分页查询。

默认值：1000

parameters.help_en:
The statistical period of the monitoring data.

Unit: seconds.

监控数据的统计周期（单位：秒），取值：

60（默认值）
60的整数倍
